lore.intro:
The Core. The vault is here.
The Congregation briefing calls the cargo the Ark.
Ratio calls it the sample vessel.
It was here before the station. The station
grew around it, like scar tissue.

Ratio is quiet for the first time.

radio.text: Ratio: ...I'll say this once, and then we work. If it offers you an ending — any ending — the offer is the weapon. Guard the door. That's all we are now.
Ratio: The vault seal answers the watchers' signet. Last door, Commando.
Ratio: The watch signet. It was waiting in the far coset. It WANTS to be found, Commando. Remember that at the door.
Ratio: The Warden is the door's idea of a guard. Show it a better one.

Ratio: The vessel's own reading says there is nothing left to save. I reran it. The threshold is pessimism dressed as precision — there is enough left to try. Believe me or don't: either way, we guard it. It'll stay quiet a thousand years, as long as someone stands here. Lucky for the universe, I know a guy. Sunward, Commando. We'll take the watch together.

terminals.text:
SITE ONE — FINAL PROTOCOL
1. Do not bargain with the door.
2. There is no rule two.

The vault holds our cargo.
The thing beneath the vault holds the door.

[SAMPLE VESSEL — EXTERNAL DIAGNOSTIC PORT]
HULL BREACH: +214y INTO TRANSIT
CRYOSTASIS: FAILED / RESTORED
PAYLOAD: NO VIABLE MATERIAL.
MAKE NO EFFORT AT RECOVERY.

[The door beneath the vault does not
speak in words. It rearranges the room
until the room is a sentence.
The sentence is an offer.]

GUARD / ACCEPT / KNEEL / BURN

[You think of Ratio. You guard.]

[TRANSLATION CONFIDENCE 22%]
this alcove held the first watcher.
it stood here four hundred / thousand /
[number does not translate] years.
it is permitted to sit.

MIRIAD PRIME ARCHIVE OFFICE — NEVER TRANSMITTED
Site One was not discovered in survey month four.
Site One has been a line item since before this
outpost's own founding charter. The charter
authorized study of a 'previously catalogued
anomaly.'
Nobody assigned to the outpost was shown the
earlier entry. We are not shown it either. Close
this file; do not forward the question upward
again.

SCRATCHED, LOW ON THE WALL, EASY TO MISS
tape measure, one (1), still on its reel, no
tape drawn out.
Someone set it down gently.

[TRANSLATION CONFIDENCE 17%]
the last watcher set its signet down here,
at the far post, where the walk ends twice.
the vault seal answers the signet, not the
hand. whoever carries it stands a watch,
knowing or not.
